key_line.detail: Adj. EPS -$0.19 beat the company's own -$0.15/-$0.65 guide near its top end and consensus (-$0.60) by a wide margin; GAAP -$1.57 includes ~$15.4m (~$1.38/sh) Catalyst restructuring charges. No quantified savings figure in the release.

guidance.detail: Q4 2026: revenue $55-75m, EPS $0.00 to +$0.25 (profit), adj. EBITDA ex interest $2-6m. FY2026: revenue $280-300m, non-GAAP loss/sh $0.45-0.70, adj. EBITDA $10-14m. The release does not state the prior FY guide; 'raised' is inferred from Q3 landing ~$0.41 better than consensus and the judges' note that FY consensus sat below the old guide's low end (not verified against the prior release).

tape_read.note: Robust reference 12.5759 = +5.95% vs prev close 11.87 (position +6.8% from 13:30 entry 11.77), above the 3.26% historical-median anchor but well short of the +14% release read and of the +22%/+34% reactions to the last two sandbag beats. Pre-market thin: 8 prints, 3 in the last 30 min, last 09:14, not stale; range 11.56-12.61, sitting near its high (ran up, not sagging). Market flat to slightly up (SPY +0.29%, IWM +0.11%).

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a sandbag beat against consensus at the bottom of the guide plus a better outlook; adj. EPS -$0.19 vs ~-$0.60 and a profitable Q4 guide confirm it. The quantified Catalyst savings number is not in the release (may have been on the call).

expected.open_lag_note: Pre-market is thin (8 prints) but not stale and sits at its high, so the open should hold most of the +6% gap; with a bmo print, the call already done and a clear beat the price has only partly read, the first half hour is a little more likely to extend than fade, against the usual gap give-back prior.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de koopreden duidelijk: het verlies per aandeel was veel kleiner dan verwacht en het bedrijf verwacht in het vierde kwartaal winst. De koers staat voorbeurs pas zo'n 6% hoger, terwijl de vorige twee vergelijkbare meevallers 22% en 34% opleverden; bij een ochtendcijfer loopt de herprijzing vaak de hele dag door. Daarom de positie aanhouden en pas bij het slot verkopen.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 terugzakt naar onder ongeveer 12,00 (de winst van vanochtend grotendeels weg), dan liever bij de opening verkopen.
